BL-1534 — bl1373PathSetCacheInvariants.property.test.js is red on main whenever the host is busy, with no owner: 40 fast-check draws each spawn one or two REAL babysitter_check.bb sweeps (1.6 s each at load 33, up to 30 per test) against a 20 s per-test timeout, so the verdict is host load (79 s / 22 s / 42 s alone at load 33; 3 of 3 pass at load 2), and invariant 1 and the cache test return green when neither sweep finds anything - the sweeps per test are bounded and stated, every draw that sweeps is decisive by construction, and a run with no decisive draw fails
What it solves: ## What is wrong
Approval context: A new feature file is authored here, so it needs a tap. No choice is posed and there are no ruling_options. FIRM: the fix is not a larger per-test timeout - at load 33 invariant 1 took 79 s, and a budget sized to the busiest host still makes the verdict a function of load (BL-871 invariant 1); the …
